key_observation: The WPR boot-registry wrapper now launches, reboots, collects, converts, filters, and normalizes cleanly through QGA without foreground shell typing.

fixes.change: Treat tracerpt exit_code=null as indeterminate rather than fatal when CSV output exists
fixes.result: successful tracerpt runs that return stdout-only completion no longer surface as tracerpt-nonzero-exit

fixes.change: Build the normalized bundle from precomputed arrays and counts instead of inline @($events) expressions inside [ordered] hashtables
fixes.result: the GuestTracerptCsvRegistryNormalizer no longer throws Argument types do not match

fixes.change: Filter tracerpt CSV into a small hit-only CSV before normalization
fixes.result: the guest normalizer works on a compact input set and still captures the matching registry rows

next_step: Use the now-stable WPR QGA lane for targeted boot-registry probes that still need runtime-trace evidence.
